scientific_integrity: The positive spanning paths and vertex-transitivity witnesses are complete finite certificates verified by standalone code; a separate subset-DP algorithm reproduces every required existence/nonexistence decision. The negative exceptional case also has an exhaustive 15-edge finite proof. Literature priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for four specified cubic symmetric girth-six graphs only; no extension to arbitrary symmetric cubic graphs or multiple vertex failures. A complete relevant 2009 publisher article was not accessible without additional authorization, and independent external audit has not been performed.
title: One-vertex-fault Hamilton laceability in four exceptional cubic symmetric girth-six graphs
